description: This file serves as an edit interface for managing relationships between security groups and users within the SuiteCRM system. It initializes dependencies, retrieves and populates relationship data, prepares the templating engine, and outputs a web form with validation scripts.

classes.name: QuickSearchDefaults
classes.description: Provides default configurations and scripts for quick search functionalities within the CRM interface.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: Handles JavaScript validation setup for the form, ensuring client-side validation rules are applied.

methods.name: getQSScripts
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code necessary to enable quick search features.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name to be validated.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarCRM bean object with the validation context.

methods.name: addToValidateBinaryDependency
methods.description: Adds validation rules for specific form fields.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Generates the JavaScript validation script for inclusion in the page.
